101.title: Loop gain magnitude, 45 PVT points × ILOAD {10 µA, 5 mA}

102.title: Loop gain phase (PM = phase at the UGF)

1.setup: stb 1 Hz to 1 GHz, probe = iprobe I0.IPRB0 inserted between the divider (LDOFBR) and the EA input (VFB) in a copy of the DUT. Spectre's loopGain phase starts at +180° for this loop, so PM is the phase at the UGF and GM is −|T| where the phase reaches 0°. Output 100p + 100m ESR. PVT × ILOAD {min, max}.

103.title: Dropout voltage vs load current, 15 process × temperature corners

ade: let((w r) w = v("VOUT" ?result 'dc) r = value(w 3.63) cross(w 0.98*r 1 "rising") - 0.98*r)
2.setup: dc sweep vin 0.5 V to 3.63 V with a resistive load RL = VOUT_NOM / ILOAD, ILOAD = 500 µA, 1.25 mA, 2.5 mA, 3.75 mA, 5 mA; VDO = VIN − VOUT where VOUT has fallen to 98% of its value at 3.63 V. VIN is swept, so the corners are P × T.

104.title: IOUT vs forced VOUT, 45 PVT points (one panel per VIN)

3.setup: dc sweep of a vsource VF forcing $DUT_OUTPUT from 0 to 1.98 V; IOUT = current the LDO drives into VF. ILIM window = 1.3× to 2.3× ILOAD max (5 mA).

140.title: Stimulus, ILOAD 10 µA → 5 mA → 10 µA, 1 µs edges (TT 3.3 V 25 °C)

105.title: VOUT deviation from its pre-step value, 45 PVT points (one panel per VIN)

4.setup: tran 0 to 100 µs, ILOAD pwl 10 µA → 5 mA at 20 µs and back at 60 µs, 1 µs edges; ΔVOUT is referred to each corner's own VOUT at 19 µs, because the DC error differs per corner.

106.title: PSRR vs frequency, ILOAD 5 mA, 45 PVT points (one panel per VIN)

5.setup: ac 10 Hz to 10 MHz, acmag 1 on the $DUT_POWER source, ILOAD = 5 mA; PSRR = −dB20(VF("/$DUT_OUTPUT")).

107.title: VOUT deviation, VIN step at 1 V/µs, ILOAD 5 mA, 15 process × temperature corners

6.setup: tran 0 to 100 µs; $DUT_POWER source pwl 2.97 → 3.63 V at 20 µs and back at 60 µs, 1 V/µs; ILOAD = 5 mA. VIN is the stimulus, so the corners are P × T.

108.title: VOUT ramp at power-up, normalised to its final value, 45 PVT points

kp.l: Max start-up time (VIN at final → VOUT 90%)

7.setup: This LDO has no EN pin, so start-up is a VIN ramp 0 → VIN over 10 µs (from 10 µs) into RL = 360 Ω (ILOAD max) + 100p; tran 0 to 1 ms. t_ss counts from VIN reaching its final value. A second scan powers up every process × VIN corner every 5 °C (TT 3.3 V every 1 °C) and records VOUT at 1 ms; a start fails when VOUT stays below half of VOUT_NOM (the reference latches at VIN).

extra.title: Power-up temperature scan: VOUT 1 ms after VIN ramps, 642 runs, 2 failed starts

kp.l: Max line regulation (VIN 2.97 → 3.63 V, ILOAD 1 mA)

8.setup: line_reg: dc sweep vin 2.97 to 3.63 V at ILOAD 1 mA, P × T corners.

114.title: Quiescent current vs load, 45 PVT points (one panel per VIN)

kp.l: Max IQ at no load (1 µA)

11.setup: dc sweep iload, log, 1 µA to 5 mA; IQ = IIN − ILOAD, η = ILOAD / IIN.

116.title: Reverse current vs VOUT − VIN, VIN = 0 V, 15 process × temperature corners

12.setup: VIN source at 0 V, vsource VR forces $DUT_OUTPUT from 0 to 1.8 V; IREV = current VR pushes into the LDO output. This LDO has no EN pin, so the EN on/off cases do not apply.

117.title: VOUT vs junction temperature, ILOAD 5 mA, 15 process × VIN corners

13.setup: dc sweep temp −40 to 165 °C at ILOAD 5 mA (static; no self-heating). The sweep stops at 165 °C because the model breaks above it (CMI-2434 at 168 °C: Vsat < 0 in I0.I8.M12). TSD_trip is where VOUT falls below half its 25 °C value; if no corner trips, this design has no thermal shutdown. The dip near −33 °C is not a shutdown: there the reference settles to a second operating point with VREF at VIN (see #7's power-up scan).

118.title: Output noise density, ILOAD 1 mA, 45 PVT points

14.setup: noise 10 Hz to 1 MHz, output VOUT referred to ground, ILOAD 1 mA.

113.title: EA input offset, μ = -2.46 mV, σ = 0.009 mV (500 Monte Carlo points, TT 3.30 V 25 °C)

10.setup: Monte Carlo, mismatch only (3 PDK mismatch sections), 500 points, seed 12345, at TT 3.30 V 25 °C, ILOAD 1 mA. The EA input pair uses device models that carry no mismatch model, so this run cannot see the EA offset: the μ is systematic offset and the σ is understated. Switch M1/M2 to the mismatch-enabled version of the device to get a real offset distribution.

15.setup: Not simulated on this install. Aging: Spectre's reliability analysis stops with SPECTRE-17074 (no aging model cards for any device in the PDK model file), so HCI/NBTI cannot be run.
